newsitem.title: USA: Verdict against Oshkosh Truck overturned.
newsitem.headline: Verdict against Oshkosh Truck overturned.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said on Thursday that a Milwaukee County Circuit Court judge overturned a $4.5 million verdict won against the company by Super Steel Products Corp in a July trial.

Judge Michael Skwierawski ruled Super Steel had failed to produce any evidence during the trial that Oshkosh had breached a purchase order for Super Steel's production of concrete mixer systems, the company said.
The judge also found Super Steel had breached its contract with Oshkosh by refusing to accept additional orders for mixer systems in May, 1994 under a firm purchase order, Oshkosh said.
The company said Judge Skwierawski ordered a new trial to determine the amount of damages suffered by Oshkosh because the jury's verdict had not provided an answer to that question, the company said.
Oshkosh Truck manufatures a wide variety of specialized trucks.
